description: Implement new Mohist workflow with inner loops, multi-agent review, and automated iteration

tasks.title: Update Stage enum and types
tasks.description: Update the Stage enum in types/index.ts to support new workflow stages: Explore, Plan, Build, Review, Done. Update issue type definitions if needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Stage enum includes Explore, Plan, Build, Review, Done
TypeScript compilation passes
Existing code that references old stages is updated or deprecated
tasks.notes: This is foundational - other tasks depend on the new stage definitions

tasks.title: Create WorkflowController base class
tasks.description: Create the WorkflowController class that manages workflow execution, stage transitions, and agent invocation. Implement basic stage execution framework.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowController can execute different stages based on issue state
Stage transition validation works correctly
Controller can invoke appropriate agents for each stage
Unit tests pass
tasks.notes: Focus on framework, not specific phase logic yet

tasks.title: Implement LoopController for inner loops
tasks.description: Create LoopController that manages inner loop execution for Plan and Review phases. Implement iteration counting, max limit enforcement, and escalation logic.
acceptanceCriteria: LoopController tracks iteration count and history
Max iteration limits (5 for Plan, 3 for Review) are enforced
Escalation to user works when max iterations reached
Loop state is persisted between iterations
tasks.notes: This is the core mechanism for iterative optimization

tasks.title: Implement MultiAgentReview orchestrator
tasks.description: Create MultiAgentReview class that can execute multiple review agents in parallel and aggregate their results. Implement result aggregation logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Can execute multiple review agents concurrently
Aggregates results into unified pass/fail decision
Collects all review outputs and issues
Handles partial failures gracefully
tasks.notes: Start with sequential execution, parallel can be added later

tasks.title: Create ChangeArtifactsManager
tasks.description: Implement ChangeArtifactsManager that handles creation, reading, and writing of change artifacts in .mohist/changes/ directory. Implement directory structure creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Can create change directory with correct structure
Can read and write artifact files
Artifacts are stored in correct locations
Git integration works (files are tracked)
tasks.notes: Git commit functionality can be basic initially

tasks.title: Implement Plan phase agents
tasks.description: Create PlanAgent that generates design artifacts (proposal, design, specs, prd.json). Create PlanReviewAgents for completeness, consistency, feasibility, and risk reviews.
acceptanceCriteria: PlanAgent generates all required artifacts
Review agents can evaluate design artifacts
Review agents return structured output with passed/reasoning/issues
Integration with LoopController works
tasks.notes: Review agents can be simple initially, iterate on quality

tasks.title: Implement Plan phase Fix agent
tasks.spec: specs/loop-controller/spec.md#Requirement: Inner loop execution for Plan phase
tasks.description: Create PlanFixAgent that can modify design artifacts based on review feedback. Implement integration with LoopController for iterative fixing.
acceptanceCriteria: FixAgent can read review feedback
FixAgent can modify design documents
FixAgent works within the inner loop
Changes are tracked in artifact history
tasks.notes: This closes the inner loop for Plan phase

tasks.title: Implement Build phase execution
tasks.description: Create Build phase execution logic that reads prd.json and sequentially executes tasks using external Coder agents (opencode). Implement task failure handling with retry and fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Can read and parse prd.json tasks
Executes tasks sequentially
Calls external Coder agents correctly
Handles task failures with retry (up to 3 times)
Escalates to user when retry fails
tasks.notes: External agent integration is critical - test thoroughly

tasks.title: Implement Review phase agents
tasks.description: Create code review agents for correctness, complexity, test coverage, and security. Implement test execution validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Review agents can analyze code
Correctness agent verifies logic
Complexity agent checks code quality
Test coverage agent validates tests
Security agent checks for vulnerabilities
tasks.notes: Test execution can be basic initially

tasks.title: Implement Review phase Fix agent
tasks.spec: specs/loop-controller/spec.md#Requirement: Inner loop execution for Review phase
tasks.description: Create CodeFixAgent that can modify code based on review feedback. Implement integration with LoopController for iterative code fixing.
acceptanceCriteria: FixAgent can read code review feedback
FixAgent can modify source code
FixAgent works within the inner loop
Changes are tracked
tasks.notes: This closes the inner loop for Review phase

tasks.title: Implement user approval interface
tasks.description: Create user approval mechanism for Plan and Review phases. Implement conversation-style interaction where system presents results and waits for user decision.
acceptanceCriteria: System can pause and wait for user approval
Approval interface shows relevant information
User can approve, request changes, or abort
State transitions work correctly based on user input
tasks.notes: UI can be CLI-based initially, web UI can be added later

tasks.title: Integrate with existing issue service
tasks.description: Update existing issue service and CLI commands to work with new workflow. Ensure backward compatibility or provide migration path.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue create/start commands work with new workflow
Existing issues can transition to new stages
Status queries return correct workflow state
Tests pass
tasks.notes: This is integration work - ensure nothing breaks

tasks.title: Add tests and documentation
tasks.description: Add comprehensive tests for new workflow components. Update documentation with new workflow usage guide.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests for all major components
Integration tests for workflow phases
Documentation updated
All tests pass
tasks.notes: Don't forget error handling and edge cases
